name: Calendar
description: A month grid for picking a single date with bounds and disabled days.
usage:
const [date, setDate] = useState(new Date())

<Calendar value={date} onSelect={setDate} />

anatomy.description: Previous and next IconButtons around an aria-live month-and-year label that announces navigation.
Locale narrow weekday names, aria-hidden so only the day buttons are read.
Forty-two day buttons covering six weeks; outside-month days are dimmed and out-of-bounds days are disabled.
The selected day exposes aria-pressed; today exposes aria-current="date" with a primary ring.

dos: Set min and max for booking-style flows so out-of-range days render disabled.
Control visibleMonth when the calendar must sync with external navigation.
Explain the disabling rule nearby when disabledDates rejects days.
donts: Don't use Calendar for ranges; use DateRangePicker.
Don't run expensive work in disabledDates; it runs once per rendered day.

examples.title: Date grid
examples.description: min, max, and disabledDates constrain selection; the month label announces changes.

examples.title: Bounded range
examples.description: min and max constrain selection to the next thirty days; out-of-range days render disabled.

guidance.useWhen: Users pick a single date from a month grid, optionally bounded by min, max, or a disabledDates predicate.
guidance.avoidWhen: The user needs a range or a field with a popover; use DateRangePicker or DatePicker.
guidance.behavior: Days are buttons with aria-pressed for the selection and aria-current="date" for today; the aria-live month label announces navigation, and the visible month can be controlled.
guidance.responsive: The grid keeps a fixed seven-column width; place it in a popover or panel on small screens.

keyboard.action: Moves focus through the month navigation buttons and the day buttons.
Selects the focused day or changes the visible month.

notes: The selected day exposes aria-pressed and today exposes aria-current="date".
Out-of-range or disabledDates days render as native disabled buttons, removed from interaction.
The month label is aria-live="polite", so previous and next navigation announces the new month.

props.description: Disables specific dates when it returns true.
props.name: disabledDates

props.description: Called when the visible month changes.
props.name: onMonthChange

props.description: Called with the date the user picks.
props.name: onSelect

props.description: Currently selected date, or null for none.
props.name: value

props.description: Controlled visible month; any day within the month is accepted.
props.name: visibleMonth
